statements.quote: Our AI business surpassed an annual revenue run rate of $37 billion, up 123% year-over-year.
statements.notes: The figure is an annualized revenue run rate as of the quarter ended 2026-03-31 (Q3 FY2026), not reported full-year revenue. 'Surpassed' means the run rate is more than $37 billion; $37 billion is a lower bound.
